company.name: FrostGate.AI
company.tagline: AI governance, evidence, and compliance control plane for regulated teams.
company.about:
FrostGate.AI builds an evidence-first governance control plane for regulated organizations adopting AI.

Most governance programs still depend on spreadsheets, screenshots, static reports, and manual control reviews. FrostGate turns that work into tenant-scoped, policy-gated, evidence-backed operations.

The platform supports AI governance assessments, connector-driven evidence collection, framework mapping, signed report generation, remediation roadmaps, audit trails, client delivery portals, and executive governance workspaces. FrostGate is designed for teams that need to prove what happened, why it happened, who approved it, and which evidence supports the decision.

Core focus areas include NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, ISO 27001, Microsoft 365 posture, OAuth risk, Entra governance, SharePoint and OneDrive exposure, endpoint inventory, DNS and email security, web security headers, remediation tracking, decision provenance, and continuous compliance workflows.

FrostGate's operating principle is simple: governance claims should be backed by evidence.

founder.name: Jason Cosat
founder.headline: Founder at FrostGate.AI | AI Governance, Evidence, and Compliance Control Plane
founder.about:
I am building FrostGate.AI, an evidence-first governance control plane for regulated organizations adopting AI.

The problem I care about is simple: AI usage is moving faster than governance teams can prove control. Most organizations can describe their policies. Far fewer can show a clean evidence trail for how AI risk was assessed, which controls were mapped, what changed, who approved it, and how remediation is progressing.

FrostGate is designed to close that gap. The platform brings together AI governance assessments, connector-driven evidence collection, framework mapping, signed reports, client portals, remediation tracking, decision provenance, and continuous governance workflows.

My focus is building governance infrastructure that stands up under audit: tenant isolation, policy enforcement, evidence lineage, deterministic reporting, and operational workflows that make compliance measurable instead of performative.

Current FrostGate focus areas include NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, ISO 27001, Microsoft 365 security posture, OAuth risk, Entra governance, SharePoint and OneDrive exposure, endpoint inventory, DNS and email security, and evidence-backed remediation.

If your organization is adopting AI and needs governance that can be proven, FrostGate.AI is being built for that problem.

posts.title: Company Launch
posts.body:
Regulated teams are adopting AI faster than they can prove governance.

That gap is where FrostGate.AI is focused.

We are building an evidence-first AI governance control plane for organizations that need more than static questionnaires and polished PDFs. FrostGate is designed to help teams collect evidence, map controls, assess risk, generate signed reports, track remediation, and operate governance workflows that can stand up under review.

The principle is simple: governance claims should be backed by evidence.

Our current platform focus includes NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, ISO 27001, Microsoft 365 posture, OAuth risk, Entra governance, SharePoint and OneDrive exposure, endpoint inventory, DNS and email security, web security headers, remediation tracking, decision provenance, and audit-ready reporting.

FrostGate.AI is for teams that need to answer:

- What evidence supports this control?
- Who approved this decision?
- What changed since the last assessment?
- Which risks are still open?

More soon as the public site is updated.

posts.title: Founder Voice
posts.body:
I am building FrostGate.AI because I think the next governance failure will not come from teams having no policies.

It will come from teams being unable to prove that their policies were enforced.

AI adoption is creating a new evidence problem. Security and compliance leaders need to know what systems were assessed, what data was reviewed, what controls were mapped, what findings were created, what remediation happened, and what changed over time.

FrostGate is built around that evidence chain.

Assessment, connectors, findings, remediation, reports, portal delivery, governance intelligence, and audit-ready exports should not live in disconnected tools.

The operating principle is simple:

Trust, but verify.
